about_the_game:
Valkyrie Rising: Hordes of Ragnarök is a horde-survivor roguelite where you battle against the unending hordes of Ragnarök to save Asgard. Unleash divine powers, survive endless waves, and build unstoppable synergies in this action-packed Norse adventure.

Survive Against Hordes of Enemies

Face endless waves of chaos as monstrous creatures swarm the battlefield. Each wave grows deadlier — only your skill, strategy, and willpower will keep you alive as you fight to reclaim Asgard.

Wield the Powers of the Gods

Channel the might of Odin, Thor, Freyja, and more. Gain divine powers through ancient runes and god-blessed skill trees — unleash lightning strikes, summon celestial weapons, or erupt the ground beneath your enemies.

Create Overpowered Builds

Stack runes, divine powers, and gauntlet upgrades to craft ridiculous synergies. Combine projectile modifiers, passive effects, and god-given skills to forge a build that destroys everything in your path.

Features:

  • Survive the Onslaught

    Battle through unending hordes of enemies that grow stronger with every passing moment. Master movement, timing, and tactics to stay alive in the chaos of Ragnarök.

  • Conquer Monstrous Bosses

    Face off against towering foes and elite enemies that guard the realms and test every ounce of your power.

  • Wield Divine Power

    Choose blessings from Odin, Thor, Freyja, and more. Shape your playstyle with god-given abilities that bend the battlefield to your will.

  • Forge Legendary Builds

    Combine mystical runes, divine skills, and gauntlet upgrades to create devastating synergies. Every run is a chance to redefine your playstyle.

  • Embark on Divine Quests

    Prove your worth to the gods by completing challenging quests. Each success earns powerful rewards and reveals more of your story.

  • Explore Asgard

    Journey through the shattered world of Asgard filled with forgotten ruins, where ancient secrets are waiting to be unearthed.

  • Grow Stronger with Every Run

    Unlock permanent upgrades, customize your abilities, and discover hidden blessings to push further with each attempt. Even in defeat, your power grows.
